messages:
incident-bot: PAGER (P1) — elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts from runtime pool us-west-2-models. Triggered for oncall: @leah. Reason: repeated SIGSEGV / OOM on model-runner.
leah: I'm picking this up. Pulling gateway dashboards and runtime logs now. @sam please join for kernel/segfault triage.
sam: joining. quick snapshot: 502/504s at gateway, multiple model-runner processes exiting with SIGSEGV then killed by OOM killer. cc @mina for kvcache insight.
mina: i see abnormal kvcache expansion tied to long-encoder requests. dumping tail logs and stack traces.
leah: error-rate timeline: 03:07 -> 03:25 UTC 5xx rate climbed from 0.12% to 5.8%, sustained spike ~20m. affected endpoint: /v1/generate (hosted-prod). fallback routing partially active but saturated.
carl: customer impact? need short blurb for CS and execs.
leah: quick AC: peak ~1.9k req/min, ~4% of active customers saw increased latencies and intermittent 5xx. top affected tenants: ledgerapp, acme-payments.
sam: pasting recent model-runner stderr snippet:
```
[2025-09-07T03:15:44Z] model-runner[pid=6210] INFO handle req id=xyz789
[2025-09-07T03:15:44Z] model-runner[pid=6210] WARN kvcache: growth to 89000 entries (~780MB) on request seq=12000
[2025-09-07T03:15:44Z] model-runner[pid=6210] FATAL signal=11 (SIGSEGV) pc=0x7f9c2d7b3a
[2025-09-07T03:15:44Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 6210 (model-runner) total-vm:2100000kB, anon-rss:1189000kB
```
mina: stacktrace points into quantized attention kernel (int8 path). mitigation plan: fail traffic to fp32 kernel variant + enforce aggressive per-request kvcache eviction.
leah: runbook actions (executed): 1) apply route tag forcing model-v2-fp32 for /v1/generate; 2) scale fallback pool by +4 nodes; 3) enable kvcache eviction ttl=20s and per-request caps.
sam: cordoning suspect nodes and collecting cores for RCA. commands run:
```
kubectl label node ip-10-0-67-21 redwood/isolated=true
kubectl drain ip-10-0-67-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force\```
ops-bot: Cancelled deployment: canary rollout model-quant-v3 scheduled 03:30 UTC (cancelled by leah).
leah: canary cancelled and blocked. no further model rollouts until root cause is confirmed.
mina: applied route-policy: fallback-fp32-lowlat to /v1/generate. early metrics: 5xx dropped to ~1.1% within 6 minutes. latency up ~15% for those requests.
carl: thx. CS to prepare banner? brief please.
customer-success: drafting banner now: "We are aware of increased errors for text-generation; mitigation is in place and intermittent failures may continue. Updates every 30 minutes." will publish in 10m.
sam: uploading collected core + logs: s3://redwood-dumps/1789012345/core-ip-10-0-67-21.tgz and s3://redwood-logs/1789012345/model-runner-stderr.log
leah: handoff summary for night: probable root cause = runaway kvcache growth in quantized attention kernel triggered by long-context encoder sequences -> memory exhaustion -> SIGSEGV/OOM -> elevated 5xx. mitigations applied: fp32 fallback routing, +4 fallback nodes, cordon two suspect nodes, cancelled canary.
leah: follow-ups (owners): @mina -> postmortem & PR to add default kvcache cap + unit tests (#INC-178901), @sam -> RCA + core analysis and stress test reproducer, @mina & infra -> add alert for kvcache entry growth and auto-fail to fp32 after N crashes. target: initial RCA 3-6h, patch MR by EOD.
sam: ack. monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/1789012345 (customer-impact widget updated). I'll keep watch and escalate if 5xx > 1% for 10m.
mina: temporary prod safeguard: default_kvcache_max_entries=65536 applied. PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/runtime/pulls/4567 referencing #INC-178901.
leah: if 5xx stays <1% for 15m we downgrade to P2. I'm handing off active monitoring to @sam; i'll be offline in 25m. handoff complete. cc: @carl @customer-success @ops-bot
sam: ack, monitoring. collecting timelines and logs for RCA. ETA for first detailed writeup: ~4 hours.
ops-bot: NOTE: billing adjustments for impacted tenants not enabled automatically. contact finance if credits needed.
